opportunities.title: Institutional Engagement Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to Society Representatives and members to host events at their organisation; applications must be supported by a Society Representative or a Fellow.
opportunities.summary: Provides funding to support Society Representatives and members to host events at their organisation, including internal conferences, teaching symposia, seminars or outreach events.

opportunities.title: Unlocking Futures Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to postdoctoral researchers who require additional support to help them achieve their full potential; members of the Society.
opportunities.summary: Provides support to postdoctoral researchers to help them achieve their full potential. Funds may be used for consumables, registration for Higher Education Academy Fellowship or other justified sundries, but not staff salaries.

opportunities.title: Education and Teaching Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to Society members wishing to develop new educational resources or conduct publishable educational research in physiological education; host institution must administer the award.
opportunities.summary: Supports members wishing to develop new educational resources or conduct a piece of publishable educational research addressing a key question in physiological education. Applications for 2026 are closed and will reopen in autumn 2026.

opportunities.title: Research and Knowledge Exchange Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to Society members wishing to conduct physiological research or knowledge exchange activities; host institution must administer the award.
opportunities.summary: Supports members wishing to conduct pilot studies, develop a new technique or finalise a project, as well as supporting activities to promote knowledge transfer and impact. Applications for 2026 are closed and will reopen in autumn 2026.

opportunities.title: Equity, Diversity and Inclusion Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to Undergraduate & Masters, Postgraduate, Full members or Fellows of the Physiological Society in their second year of membership or longer.
opportunities.summary: Provides support for Members to run activities that address equity, diversity and inclusion principles in the physiological sciences, in either teaching or research. Applications closed for 2026 and will reopen in 2027.

opportunities.title: The Paton Historical Studies Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to Members to promote research or engagement activities in the history of modern physiology.
opportunities.summary: Small grants to promote research or engagement activities in the history of modern physiology. Applications are now closed for 2026.

opportunities.title: Conference Attendance Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to Society members (Undergraduate & Masters, Postgraduate, Full and Fellow). Postgraduate, Full and Fellow member applicants must be submitting/presenting an abstract at the meeting they wish to attend.
opportunities.summary: Awards intended primarily to support member engagement at the Society's own meetings, and where funding allows, attendance at Society-sponsored events. Covers registration and attendance at meeting dinners, with a contribution toward travel and accommodation.
